name: webx/rich-text
title: WebX: Rich text
description: A block of narrative paragraphs. Synced into page.acf.blocks as a "rich-text" block. Deliberately exposes only escaped `paragraphs`, never the raw-HTML `html` field this type also supports server-side — same reasoning as this template's own established rule against ever exposing a raw-HTML field to editors (see governance.ts's hasEmbedBlock gate).
